headline: Het Steen Antwerp - Visitor Center and Tourist Reception / noAarchitecten
context: The eventful construction history of Het Steen lies at the basis of the design. After centuries of being part of the city walls, the collection of buildings acquired a freestanding character around 1890 after the straightening of the Scheldt, known as Het Steen of Antwerp.
